services.title: Emergency Burst Pipe Repair
services.desc: Water spraying from your walls at 2am? We attend burst pipes within the hour, day or night. Diagnosis, repair, and damage mitigation all covered.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New condensing boiler fitted with a 10-year warranty and annual servicing plan. We handle all the paperwork and guarantee efficiency gains on your heating bills.

services.title: Central Heating Repairs
services.desc: Cold radiators, noisy pipes, or a boiler that won't ignite? We diagnose and fix most faults the same day, with parts always in the van.

services.title: Annual Boiler Service
services.desc: Keep your warranty valid and your heating running smoothly. Annual safety check, clean, and performance test — from just £59.

services.title: Leaking Radiator & Pipework
services.desc: Spot water stains or puddles under your radiators? We locate leaks fast, repair or replace the section, and flush the system to prevent corrosion.

services.title: Powerflush & System Cleaning
services.desc: Black sludge and cold spots slowing down your heating? A powerflush clears blockages and improves efficiency by up to 30%.

about_pullquote: We fix plumbing right the first time — no shortcuts, no fancy invoices.
about_para_1: Reliable Plumbing & Heating was started 18 years ago in South Oxhey after one too many cowboy jobs left our neighbours out of pocket. We're Gas Safe registered, carry all parts on the van, and pride ourselves on getting you back to hot water and heating fast — whether it's midnight on a Sunday or Tuesday morning.
about_para_2: Our customers stay with us because we answer the phone, show up on time, and charge fair prices with no surprises. We've built our reputation one burst pipe and one winter at a time across Watford and the surrounding areas. If you're stuck, we'll be there.
reviews_heading: What Watford Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a leaking radiator the day before Christmas. Called Reliable at 6pm and the lad was at the house by 7. Fixed it in under an hour, charged a fair price, and even left the place tidy. Can't fault them. Will be using again next year.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Our boiler gave up at the worst possible time. Rang in the morning and they had a new one fitted by evening. Really professional throughout, explained everything, and the paperwork was all sorted. Ten-year warranty gives us peace of mind. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Linda M.

reviews.text: Called for an emergency at midnight — burst pipe in the kitchen. They actually answered. Got here in 45 minutes, fixed it properly, and didn't charge a fortune like some places would. Proper old-school service. Will keep their number on the fridge.
reviews.author: James P.
